panels.title: Hottest
panels.description: Warmest reading on the node, and the chip it came from.

targets.expr: topk(1, max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node"}))

panels.title: Closest to limit
panels.description: The temperature sitting nearest its own chip's threshold, as a share of it.

targets.expr: max(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node"}) / on (chip, sensor) group_left () max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_limit_celsius{node="$node"})) * 100

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Alarm bits the chips themselves have set. Zero is the expected reading.

targets.expr: count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_alarm{node="$node"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Sensors
panels.description: Readable hwmon sensors across every chip on the node.

targets.expr: (count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node"})) or vector(0)) + (count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_fan_rpm{node="$node"})) or vector(0)) + (count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_voltage_volts{node="$node"})) or vector(0)) + (count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_power_watts{node="$node"})) or vector(0)) + (count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_frequency_hertz{node="$node"})) or vector(0))

count(count by (chip) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node"} or talos_sensor_fan_rpm{node="$node"} or talos_sensor_voltage_volts{node="$node"} or talos_sensor_power_watts{node="$node"} or talos_sensor_frequency_hertz{node="$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fans
panels.description: Fans reporting a speed, and the slowest of them. A fan at 0 rpm has stopped.

targets.expr: count(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_fan_rpm{node="$node"})) or vector(0)
min(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_fan_rpm{node="$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Power draw
panels.description: Power the chips report. Covers only rails with a sensor, not the whole machine.

targets.expr: sum(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_power_watts{node="$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Every temperature sensor on the node.

targets.expr: max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node"})

panels.title: Fans
panels.description: Fan speeds. A line dropping to zero is a fan that stopped.

targets.expr: max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_fan_rpm{node="$node"})
max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_power_watts{node="$node"})

panels.title: Voltages
panels.description: Voltage rails. These should be flat — movement is a supply problem.

targets.expr: max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_voltage_volts{node="$node"})

panels.title: Frequencies
panels.description: Clocks reported through hwmon, typically GPU engine and memory clocks.

targets.expr: max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_frequency_hertz{node="$node"})

panels.title: Temperatures now
panels.description: Every temperature right now, hottest first.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (chip_name, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node"}))
